landing.problemTitle: The Cost of Fragmented Technical Knowledge
landing.problemDesc: Frontline technicians lose critical operational hours searching 600-page OEM manuals or waiting for senior engineers. ForgeWise AI provides traceable, verified answers in seconds.
landing.ragDesc: Combines vector similarity with exact token search for error codes, part numbers, and hydraulic ratings. If evidence is lacking, it delivers an honest refusal.
landing.citationsDesc: Every parameter connects directly to verified document versions and page numbers with side-by-side inspection.
landing.multilingualDesc: Full support for English and Hindi interfaces while preserving Latin engineering tags and part numbers.
landing.safetyDesc: Mandatory Lockout/Tagout (LOTO) callouts prepend any hazardous maintenance procedure.
